# Section 030: Governance With Policy Engines And Admission Control

Makes the reader able to enforce platform rules at admission time with the three tools the exam uses: Kyverno, Gatekeeper (OPA and Rego) and the built-in ValidatingAdmissionPolicy with CEL. It follows the mesh section because the policies here govern objects from every earlier section, and it comes before audit because policy reports are part of the compliance evidence.

**Curriculum item covered:** Using Policy Engines and Admission Controllers for Governance

---

## What You Will Master

- Write a validate rule that rejects pods without resource limits in selected namespaces
- Switch a policy between Enforce and Audit and read the effect in a PolicyReport
- Write a mutate rule that adds a default label or securityContext field to matching pods
- Write a generate rule that creates a default-deny NetworkPolicy in every new namespace
- Read a Kyverno admission rejection and name the policy and rule that blocked it
- Exempt one workload from a rule with a PolicyException instead of weakening the policy
- Write a ConstraintTemplate with a Rego violation rule and the parameter schema for its constraint
- Create a Constraint that applies the template to selected kinds and namespaces with parameters
- Switch a Constraint between deny, dryrun and warn with enforcementAction
- Read the audit results in a Constraint's status and list existing violations
- Find the error in a ConstraintTemplate whose Rego does not compile from its status
- Write a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy with a CEL expression that limits Deployment replicas
- Bind it to selected namespaces with a ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding and choose Deny, Warn or Audit
- Pass a limit through a params resource instead of hard-coding it
- Choose between ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, Kyverno and Gatekeeper for a given rule and say why

---

## The Learning Path

### 1. Validate, Mutate And Generate With Kyverno
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 1: Validate, Mutate And Generate With Kyverno](./module-01/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-030/module-01/playground` — kind cluster with Kyverno 1.19.1 installed by Helm (admission, background and reports controllers), webhooks ready. Namespaces `starfleet` and `outpost` with the Starfleet workloads; `probe` has no resource limits and `scout` has no `team` label (objects existing policies will flag in background scans). No ClusterPolicy or PolicyException yet.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS021.git -c sections/section-030/module-01/playground
    ```

### 2. Enforce Constraints With Gatekeeper And Rego
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 2: Enforce Constraints With Gatekeeper And Rego](./module-02/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-030/module-02/playground` — kind cluster with Gatekeeper 3.23.1 installed by Helm, no Kyverno. Namespaces `starfleet` and `outpost` with the Starfleet workloads; `drifter` uses an image tag `latest` and `probe` has no `team` label, so audit finds violations once a constraint exists. One prepared ConstraintTemplate `k8sbrokenlabels` with a Rego syntax error (to read its status). No working ConstraintTemplate or Constraint yet.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS021.git -c sections/section-030/module-02/playground
    ```

### 3. Write ValidatingAdmissionPolicies With CEL
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 3: Write ValidatingAdmissionPolicies With CEL](./module-03/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-030/module-03/playground` — kind cluster, no policy engine installed (the API server does the work). Namespaces `starfleet` (labelled `environment: production`) and `outpost` (labelled `environment: sandbox`) with the Starfleet workloads; a `scout` Deployment scaled to 8 replicas so a replica limit has something to reject. A ConfigMap `replica-limits` in `starfleet` to use as params. No ValidatingAdmissionPolicy yet.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS021.git -c sections/section-030/module-03/playground
    ```

### Section Capstone Challenge
*   **Comprehensive Challenge:** Governance With Policy Engines And Admission Control Capstone — `sections/section-030/capstone/labs/lab-01` *(created in the build phase)*
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS021.git -c sections/section-030/capstone/labs/lab-01
    astrona submit -c .
    ```
*   **Hands-on Objective:** A platform must enforce three rules: every pod in team namespaces has CPU and memory limits (Kyverno, Enforce), no container uses the `latest` tag (Gatekeeper constraint), and production Deployments have at most five replicas (ValidatingAdmissionPolicy). One existing workload needs a documented Kyverno PolicyException. The grader applies objects that must be rejected and accepted for each rule and checks the Gatekeeper audit and the PolicyReport.
